data.long_meaning: Mukul is derived from the Sanskrit word 'mukula' which means 'bringer of joy, pleasure'. In Hindu mythology, Mukul is associated with Lord Krishna and represents the joy and happiness that comes from within. The name is also believed to bring good fortune and prosperity. The name Mukul carries the meaning “Bringer of joy, pleasure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mukul usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of joy, pleasure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
